command: set -u; PID=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value 2>/dev/null || true); echo "PID=$PID"; echo '=== service ==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart -p MemoryCurrent -p CPUUsageNSec -p TasksCurrent --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== installed hashes ==='; for f in /home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_final_runtime.py /home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/scripts/voice_full_runtime.py /home/ai-core-node/.local/lib/frankenstein-voice-final/DEV_SOURCE_RESEARCH/repository/scripts/realtime_gespraech.py; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then sha256sum "$f"; fi; done; echo '=== process threads ==='; if [ -n "$PID" ] && [ "$PID" != 0 ]; then ps -o pid,ppid,etimes,%cpu,%mem,nlwp,rss,vsz,stat,cmd -p "$PID"; ps -L -o pid,tid,psr,pcpu,stat,comm -p "$PID" | tail -30; fi; echo '=== top cpu ==='; ps -eo pid,etimes,%cpu,%mem,rss,comm,args --sort=-%cpu | head -18; echo '=== recent voice journal ==='; journalctl --user -u frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service --since '45 minutes ago' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Response-Release|Response-Emission|antwortet|FranKenstein:|Gabriel:|Appraisal|Retrieval|realtime|Realtime|Fehler|error|timeout|Stille|transcript|Transkript|Kontext|GRID|TITAN' | tail -260 || true
